response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical credentials with 18+ years of software engineering experience and proven entrepreneurial success founding GISCollective, he does not meet the core requirements for this Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. Most critically, he holds a Staff Software Engineer position rather than the required Director-level individual contributor status. Additionally, his AI/ML experience is limited to 4 months at his current role building AI infrastructure—insufficient depth for a position requiring recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms. He also lacks an advanced degree in AI, a preferred qualification.
strengths: Exceeds 15-year experience requirement with 18+ years across diverse software engineering domains and technologies
Demonstrates entrepreneurial leadership as founder of GISCollective, an open-source geo-data platform with 10-year track record and real-world adoption
Recently expanding into AI infrastructure work at re:cinq with MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
concerns: Currently at Staff Software Engineer level, not the Director-level individual contributor seniority required for this principal role
Only 4 months of AI/ML infrastructure experience; lacks deep, recognized expertise in AI and no demonstrated AI-powered products or platforms
No advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in AI-related field and no evidence of AI thought leadership, publications, or recognized industry recognition in AI domain

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and demonstrated AI products
